title: Executive brief
description: A short report for leadership: the executive summary, the findings at a glance (severity, systems affected, status), the scope, and what to do about each finding — no evidence, reproduction steps or host lists. Addenda show only the changes table.

assets.label: Company logo
assets.description: Word: in place of the YOUR LOGO placeholder on the title page and in the header of every page, scaled to fit a 1.7 × 0.5 inch box. HTML: above the report title, up to 2 inches wide. A PNG with a transparent background reads best. Each template carries its own branding: install it here even if the Penetration test report already has one.

assets.label: Title page image
assets.description: Word: in place of the COVER IMAGE placeholder on the title page, scaled to fit a 7.5 × 5 inch box (a 3:2 landscape picture fills it).
assets.note: Without it the title page shows the grey COVER IMAGE placeholder; to have no picture there, remove it from your own Word styles file.

assets.label: Word styles (reference.docx)
assets.description: Fonts, colours, heading and table styles, page size, the title page and the header/footer of the Word brief. Start from a copy of the shipped reference.docx, change its styles in Word (not its body text) and save it here.
